This is the whole of week 2, with the freezer swaps already made. Cook and shop from this page, not from the main site - everything below already accounts for what is in the freezer.

  • Salmon traybake4 basa fillets and 1 salmon from the freezer, plus 300g mini corn cobs on the tray. Basa cooks 12-15 minutes, not 15-20.
  • Wednesday fried rice300g sweetcorn, 200g edamame and 100g peas from the freezer instead of the bagged stir fry veg.
  • Thursday lunch boxesPrawns from the freezer. Defrost Wednesday night.
  • Breakfast bagsBerries from the freezer. Mix it up: blueberry, raspberry, mango, mixed berry.
  • All lunch boxesA spoonful of edamame in each, about 30g. Extra protein.
  • Tuna pasta saladPeas from the freezer.
  • Wednesday finisherSweetcorn and coriander, as in week 1.
  • Chicken thighs800g from the freezer. Use it before opening anything bought - defrost Thursday night.

The week

Sunday

Slow Roast Pork Shoulder Serves 4

Low and slow, in early. Wednesday's fried rice comes out of the leftovers.

  • 2kg pork shoulder, skin scored
  • Sunday's share of the pork
  • 800g potatoes for roasting
  • 500g carrots
  • 1 head broccoli
  • 1 tbsp oil
  • Apple sauce
  • Gravy
  1. Skin scored, salted hard, left uncovered in the fridge overnight if you remember.
  2. Oven 220C for 30 minutes to start the crackling, then down to 150C for 4-5 hours.
  3. Potatoes and veg in for the last hour, oven back up to 200C for the final 20 minutes.
  4. Rest 20 minutes. Pull or slice.
  5. Set aside ~300g diced for Wednesday's fried rice before it all disappears.

~885 kcal · 60g protein · 60g carbs · 45g fat · 10g fibre

Monday

Tandoori Chicken Bowls Serves 4

Thighs roasted Saturday alongside the lunch box batch. Warm or cold, both fine.

  • 600g tandoori thighs from Saturday
  • 125g yoghurt for the marinade
  • 2 tsp tandoori spice
  • 2 rice pouches
  • 1 cucumber, in ribbons
  • A bag of leaves
  • Mango chutney
  • A lemon, in wedges
  1. Rice pouches in the microwave.
  2. Thighs sliced, warmed 2 minutes or served cold.
  3. Mint yoghurt from the fridge, chutney, cucumber and leaves on the table. Build your own.

~465 kcal · 35g protein · 47g carbs · 15g fat · 3g fibre

Tuesday

Dal with Rice Serves 4

Tuesday's tub of dal from Saturday.

  • 4 portions of Dal
  • 2 rice pouches
  • Greek yoghurt
  1. Dal into a pan on low, 10 minutes. It thickens - loosen with a splash of water.
  2. Rice pouches at the last minute.

~575 kcal · 25g protein · 78g carbs · 16g fat · 12g fibre

Wednesday

Pork Fried Rice Serves 4

Freezer version. Make the lot at the first sitting, microwave per person after.

  • 300g leftover pork, diced
  • 2 rice pouches
  • 3 eggs
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 garlic cube
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 1 tbsp oil
  • Spring onions, sliced
  • 300g sweetcorn (from freezer)
  • 200g edamame (from freezer)
  • 100g peas (from freezer)
  1. Pork crisped in a hot pan, 3 minutes.
  2. Frozen veg and garlic in, 4 minutes.
  3. Rice pouches broken in, soy over, tossed 3 minutes.
  4. Eggs scrambled into a gap in the pan, then stirred through.
  5. Sesame oil off the heat. Spring onions on top.

~665 kcal · 39g protein · 53g carbs · 32g fat · 8g fibre

Thursday

Chicken & Chickpea Korma Freezer Bag Serves 4

Yoghurt goes on the side when serving, not in the bag.

  • 6 boneless chicken thighs (~600g)
  • Half a jar of korma paste
  • 1 tin chickpeas, drained
  • 150g frozen onion
  • 1 tin light coconut milk
  • 1 tsp garam masala
  • A handful of frozen spinach
  1. Everything into a freezer bag, raw. Seal, label KORMA + the month, freeze flat.
  2. Wednesday bedtime: into the fridge.
  3. Thursday morning: into the slow cooker on low.

Rice pouches, yoghurt on the side, mango chutney.

~435 kcal · 35g protein · 19g carbs · 24g fat · 5g fibre

Friday

Margherita, the Boys' Serves 2

Dough out of the freezer into the fridge on Thursday night.

  • 2 dough balls
  • 200g passata
  • 2 balls mozzarella
  • 1 tbsp oil
  1. Oven as hot as it goes with the tray or stone in it.
  2. Dough stretched by hand, not rolled. Passata thin, cheese torn on.
  3. 8-12 minutes depending on the oven.

~1075 kcal · 45g protein · 132g carbs · 38g fat · 7g fibre

Tandoori Chicken, the Adults' Serves 2

Chutney dotted on after it comes out, not before.

  • 1 dough ball
  • 80g passata
  • 200g chicken thigh
  • 1 tsp tandoori spice
  • 1 tsp oil
  • 60g mozzarella
  • Mango chutney, after
  1. Chicken tossed in spice and oil, on the passata, cheese over. Chutney dotted on once it's out.

~605 kcal · 35g protein · 72g carbs · 18g fat · 4g fibre

Cucumber & Tomato Salad Serves 4

Cooling, to sit next to the tandoori pizza.

  • A bag of leaves
  • 1 cucumber
  • 150g tomatoes
  • Pickled onions
  • 4 boiled eggs
  • 20g seeds
  • Mint yoghurt from the jar
  • A little chutney
  • A squeeze of lemon
  1. Cucumber in half-moons, tomatoes in wedges. Mint yoghurt loosened with lemon, spooned over.

~155 kcal · 11g protein · 8g carbs · 9g fat · 2g fibre

Saturday

Glazed Basa & Salmon Traybake Serves 4

Freezer version. Basa cooks faster than salmon, so it goes in later.

  • 4 basa fillets (from freezer)
  • 1 salmon fillet (from freezer)
  • 300g mini corn cobs (from freezer)
  • 500g baby potatoes, halved
  • 1 head broccoli, in florets
  • 150g cherry tomatoes, halved
  • 2 tbsp oil
  • Dried herbs
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce (glaze)
  • 1 tbsp honey (glaze)
  • 1 lemon
  • Fresh dill or parsley
  1. Potatoes and mini corn cobs in first, 200C, 20 minutes.
  2. Broccoli and tomatoes in, glaze whisked and brushed over the fish.
  3. Fish on top. Basa needs 12-15 minutes, not the 15-20 salmon wants - watch it, it goes from done to dry quickly.
  4. Herbs and lemon over at the table.

~415 kcal · 32g protein · 38g carbs · 16g fat · 7g fibre

Made on Saturday

Dal Serves 8

Mild base. The tarka is an adults-only pour-over at the table.

  • 1 tbsp oil
  • 2 onions, diced (or 200g frozen)
  • 3 cloves garlic, crushed
  • Thumb of fresh ginger, grated
  • 2 tsp turmeric
  • 2 tsp ground cumin
  • 500g red lentils, rinsed
  • 1 tin chickpeas, drained
  • 1 tin chopped tomatoes
  • 1 tin light coconut milk
  • 1.2L vegetable stock
  • 100g frozen spinach
  • 1 tsp garam masala
  • Juice of half a lemon
  1. Onion, garlic and ginger in oil for 3 minutes.
  2. Turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.
  3. Lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and stock in. Simmer 30 minutes.
  4. Spinach and garam masala for the last 5 minutes.
  5. Lemon juice at the end. Salt to taste.

With rice pouches and a spoon of yoghurt.

~360 kcal · 20g protein · 45g carbs · 9g fat · 10g fibre

Tandoori Thighs for the Boxes Serves 4

Marinate first thing, roast when the oven frees up. Monday's bowls come off the same tray - cook 1kg total.

  • 400g boneless chicken thighs
  • 60g Greek yoghurt
  • 2 tsp tandoori spice
  • Squeeze of lemon
  1. Yoghurt, spice and lemon mixed, thighs turned through it. 200C for 30-35 minutes until the edges char.

~145 kcal · 20g protein · 1g carbs · 6g fat · 0.4g fibre

Lunch Box Veg Tray Serves 10

One big tray, 100g per box.

  • 1 head broccoli, in florets
  • Half a cauliflower
  • 2 carrots, in batons
  • 1 red onion, in wedges
  • 1.5 tbsp oil
  1. Everything on the biggest tray, oiled and salted. 200C for 25-30 minutes. Cool completely.

~50 kcal · 2g protein · 7g carbs · 2g fat · 2g fibre

Mint Yoghurt Serves 10

The one dressing that will not keep a month - make it fresh in week 2.

  • 300g Greek yoghurt
  • A handful of mint, chopped
  • Juice of 1 lemon
  1. Mint chopped fine, stirred through the yoghurt with the lemon and a good pinch of salt.

~35 kcal · 2g protein · 2g carbs · 3g fat · 0.1g fibre

Lunch Box, Week 2 Serves 1

Ten of these - five each. Built bottom-to-top so the leaves stay out of the dressing. The protein changes by day and is not in this base.

  • 1 portion of Mint Yoghurt
  • 1 portion of Lunch Box Veg Tray
  • Half a rice pouch
  • 50g tinned beans
  • A spoonful of pickled onions
  • A handful of leaves
  • A spoonful of edamame (from freezer)
  1. Dressing in the bottom.
  2. Rice, then beans, then roast veg.
  3. Pickled onions, then leaves on top.
  4. Protein goes in by day - roast Monday and Tuesday, then mackerel, prawns, tuna and egg. Only Monday and Tuesday's go in on Saturday.
  5. Finisher goes on the day, not now - especially the crunchy ones.

~375 kcal · 15g protein · 53g carbs · 11g fat · 9g fibre

Cinnamon & Raisin Flapjacks Serves 12

First thing in the oven at 180C.

  • 250g oats
  • 60g protein powder
  • 150g peanut butter
  • 100g honey
  • 75g butter
  • 1 ripe banana, mashed
  • 50g mixed seeds
  • 80g raisins, plus 2 tsp cinnamon
  1. Butter, peanut butter and honey melted together in a pan.
  2. Off the heat, everything else stirred in.
  3. Pressed hard into a lined tin.
  4. 180C for 22-25 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into 12.

~300 kcal · 11g protein · 29g carbs · 16g fat · 4g fibre

Into the boxes on the day

Smoked Mackerel for Wednesday's Boxes Serves 2

Not made Saturday. Skin off, flaked straight into the box on Wednesday morning.

  • 2 smoked mackerel fillets (~160g)
  • A squeeze of lemon
  1. Skin off, flaked into the box on the day. Squeeze of lemon over.

~245 kcal · 15g protein · 0.3g carbs · 20g fat · 0g fibre

Prawns for Thursday's Boxes Serves 2

Not made Saturday. Straight from the pack into the box on Thursday morning.

  • 160g cooked peeled prawns
  1. Into the box on the day, on top of the leaves.

~80 kcal · 18g protein · 0g carbs · 0.7g fat · 0g fibre

Tuna and Egg for Friday's Boxes Serves 2

Not made Saturday. Tuna and two halved eggs into the box on Friday morning.

  • 4 portions of Boiled Eggs
  • 160g tinned tuna in spring water, drained
  • Rounds the tuna up to 2 whole tins
  1. Tuna drained and forked in, two boiled eggs halved on top.

~250 kcal · 35g protein · 0.8g carbs · 12g fat · 0g fibre

Lunches10 boxes, 5 each

Same base every day. The protein changes, and every box gets a spoonful of edamame this week.

  • Monday 80g Tandoori Thighs for the Boxes in on Saturday Finisher: 1 tbsp mango chutney and coriander ~570 kcal · 35g protein · 67g carbs · 18g fat · 10g fibre
  • Tuesday 80g Tandoori Thighs for the Boxes in on Saturday Finisher: 40g cucumber and a spoon of mint yoghurt with toasted cumin ~560 kcal · 37g protein · 58g carbs · 20g fat · 10g fibre
